name: List Stripe Connected Accounts
description: Lists connected accounts (Stripe Connect). Compresses responses by removing deeply nested settings, requirements, and dashboard fields while preserving account identity, capabilities, and status.

stripeConnectionKey.description: Stripe connection key (must be a platform/Connect account)

createdAfter.description: Filter accounts created after this Unix timestamp

createdBefore.description: Filter accounts created before this Unix timestamp

startingAfter.description: Cursor for pagination (account ID to start after)

steps.name: Strip deeply nested verbose fields from each account
